artifact_observations.reasoning: The hand exhibits significant motion blur and lack of structural definition. While this could be photographic motion blur, in AI generation, hands often melt or distort. The fingers lack clear separation and nail details, appearing as fleshy blobs.

The texture of the pan bottom has a slightly 'noisy' or stippled appearance that doesn't perfectly match standard brushed metal or cast iron. It looks somewhat like generated noise rather than precise machining marks.
The thick rolled rim on the left side softens into the background blur slightly unnaturally, lacking a crisp geometric edge, though this may be due to depth of field.
